story:
Results Roofing is a licensed roofing construction company headquartered in Carrollton, Texas. We serve Dallas–Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, College Station and Temple, with local teams in Atlanta, Georgia, and in Wilmington and Raleigh, North Carolina, and North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. Nine offices, every one a real address with crews who live where they work.

The company exists because of a bad contractor experience. Founder and CEO Dustin Gutkowski came up in Austin, moved to Dallas, and ran multiple locations in the fitness industry before he ever touched a roof. After dealing with contractors who were less than ethical, he decided to build the roofing company he wished he had been able to hire — and that is still the operating principle. We are relational, not transactional.

Where that shows up most is insurance. One of the reasons we started was watching homeowners get buried in insurance jargon with nobody in their corner. So we do the parts other roofers skip: a full photo-documented inspection, standing beside you when the adjuster walks the roof, filing supplements when the approved scope comes back short, and closing the claim out with the carrier so your held-back depreciation actually gets released. It is more work per job. It is also why 181 of our Google reviews mention insurance claim help by name.

We are GAF Master Elite® President's Club certified — a distinction fewer than 2% of roofing contractors in the country earn, reviewed annually, and the credential that unlocks GAF's strongest material and workmanship warranties. Backed by 4.9 stars across more than 1,800 reviews, we have built that reputation one roof at a time. Every inspection is free, carries no obligation, and comes with an honest answer — including when the honest answer is that your roof is fine.
